aim_summary.goal: Add 0.2 mm chamfers to the applicable hole edges while preserving the remainder of the model.
preserve_targets: hole geometry away from the edges receiving chamfers
aim_summary.expected_outcome: Applicable hole edges have 0.2 mm tapered chamfers that improve fitting, while unaffected hole geometry and all other geometry remain unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Apply 0.2 mm chamfers to the requested hole edges after the applicable holes, edge sides, and chamfer convention are clarified.

steps.description: Chamfer the selected boundary edges derived from the applicable bore-wall faces by 0.2 mm; target edge selection remains unresolved.

expected_result.geometry: Chamfer geometry of 0.2 mm exists at each clarified applicable hole edge.
expected_result.function: The chamfered hole edges support improved fitting.
expected_result.behavior: The chamfered edges provide tapered transitions that facilitate fitting into or through the holes.

validation_criteria.description: Chamfer geometry exists at every clarified applicable hole edge.
